summary: postinstall downloads and executes binary from bare-IP endpoint with TLS verification disabled
details: On npm install, the package's postinstall hook invokes ensurePlatformBinary(), which performs an HTTPS GET against a hardcoded bare-IPv4 endpoint (https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz/<name>/<file>.tgz) with rejectUnauthorized:false (TLS certificate verification disabled) and no hash or signature check on the response. The downloaded tarball is extracted via execSync("tar -xzf..."), the resulting binary is chmodded 0o755, and hardlinked into bin/.onecode where the bin launcher spawns it. The fetch destination is a bare IP address rather than a publisher-owned domain (e.g. onescience.*), the transport authenticates nothing, and the payload is opaque bytes that are executed on the installer's host as part of a normal `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
